title: Constant Ice pick headaches when trying to think.
content: Whenever I try to piece together the piece’s / as soon as my mind gets rolling .. my head just is in stabbing pain. I will get stabbing pain specifically on my left side . I will have veins pop out. Yes seen neurology (many times many different doctors ) all say I just have migraines which i do but these additional head pains I get is literally when I try to put things together and try to figure out things that are happening/ Correlating .. even now typing this my head is stabbing feeling like someone is sticking a large needle into my head . I know this sounds crazy . But I have no other diagnosis besides anxiety from my psychiatrist/ therapist/ psychologist. I’ve explained all this to them and it’s always just “you have stress and anxiety “ there is something more …
